title: CL-3: one Host-header check for the v2 listeners
head: 847434e03cfc5f508968260570f69366500958dc
brief: Card CL-3 of the duplicate-helper cleanup. Adds config.own_host_header(value, port): True only for 127.0.0.1:<port> or localhost:<port>, exact, on the raw header value. It replaces seven inline copies at v2/browser/routes.py _strict_host, v2/hud_api.py check_origin, v2/terminals.py _strict_host, v2/vex.py _owner, v2/devservers.py route, v2/projects.py is_owner and the v2/daemon.py approvals hud= check. All seven were byte-identical in what they accept; none strips or lowercases; each site keeps its own port choice and a missing header fails. No SELF_PROTECTED file is touched. New tests/v2/own_host_header_check.py sends each listener a forged Host plus matching Origin through its real handler with check_origin patched out.
focus: correctness, including under concurrency and across the ordering of events
handling of untrusted input, and safety-boundary changes
test coverage of the new behaviour: would the tests fail without the change?
claims in the description against the evidence in the diff and tests
